summaries.genai-wingify: GenAI Engineer with 3.5+ years of experience and expertise in Python, agentic AI systems, RAG, and backend services powering GenAI features. Built a multi-agent AI system and a RAG-based agent with a vector-store-backed knowledge base at Turbot HQ, cutting resource-discovery latency 70-90% through AI-driven automation that translated business security requirements into production systems.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Designed a multi-agent AI system on the OpenAI Agents SDK — a production agentic-orchestration framework — translating a business security requirement into an automated technical solution: LLM agents that generate policy commands, validate them in a live test environment, self-correct failures, and score outcomes against an internal evaluation metric.

Built a RAG-based Pydantic AI agent with a knowledge base spanning internal documentation and code, ingested as embeddings into AWS S3 vector storage; deployed to AWS Lambda and integrated with Slack to translate cross-team business queries into instant, context-aware answers.

Built the Steampipe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server end to end in Python, giving LLM agents standardized, real-time access to enterprise cloud and security data — a backend service powering production GenAI features.

Authored an LLM-driven Claude Code skill automating code refactoring, unit test generation, deployment, and PR creation; used it to migrate 35+ Azure cloud-governance modules to event-driven eventing, cutting resource-discovery latency 70-90% — a measurable business-impact win from agentic automation.

Led the AWS SDK for JavaScript v2 to v3 migration across 180+ call sites and 11+ AWS services in production Node.js Lambdas; reduced policy-code duplication ~60% via templating, keeping the platform supported past AWS SDK v2 EOL.
Built a Kafka-based, event-driven distributed pipeline where consumers asynchronously processed policy-enforcement events; added a dead-letter queue (DLQ) for reliable failure handling and debugging.
Owned release engineering for four open-source Go CLIs — unified GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows and automated testing, hardening release safety and catching regressions before deployment.

projects.name: Lila Tic-Tac-Toe — Real-Time Multiplayer Game
projects.description: Built end to end in 4 days: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite frontend on Vercel; Nakama game server (Go core + TS runtime) on Fly.io with PostgreSQL. Server-authoritative anti-cheat over WebSocket transport, mode-aware matchmaking via KV-storage queues, tick-based turn timer, optimistic UI with revert-on-validation-failure, top-10 leaderboard, and reconnect-into-active-match — full-stack, real-time distributed system.
